fees.description: A $13.20 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is reconnected (including when you move). Fee may vary.
A $13.20 (GST Incl) fee may apply when your property is disconnected (including when you move). Fee may vary.
A fee of $15.00 (GST exempt) may apply if your bill is not paid by the due date.
If you pay at an Australia Post outlet, a payment processing fee of the higher of $2.70 or 0.49% (incl GST) may apply.
$2.15 (incl GST) applies for each paper bill.

gasContract.terms: Not available all areas or property types. Small Business customers only. Visit originenergy.com.au/2889/Terms-and-conditions to find out more.
gasContract.variation: We may vary the Charges (including their amount, nature and structure) by notice to you at any time. For increases, notice will be at least 10 business days prior, for decreases, the notice will be at least 5 business days prior to the effective date
gasContract.additionalFeeInformation: You may be required to pay any amounts that a Distributor or Meter Service Provider charges us for services provided at your Supply Address, including any metering-related goods or services, and which are not already incorporated into the Supply Charges or Energy Usage Charges. You can find out more at www.originenergy.com.au/1612/Additional-charges
